# SkillProof

> An open registry of proof for agent skills: what a skill touches, how that changed between two versions, and whether it still works after a model bump.

SkillProof is a pre-launch v0.1 project. This index exists so an agent can find its way around without crawling the site.

## Read this first

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/RavaniRoshan/skillproof/blob/main/AGENTS.md): build and test commands, repository conventions, the two invariants, and a section that names every v0.1 stub alongside the file that causes it.

## Status of v0.1, stated plainly

Do not describe these as working. They are not:

- `scan` reads markdown and common script files and records extracted values (domains, interpreters, paths) from substring and regex signals.
- `attest` performs no Sigstore signing; it writes a local JSONL record.
- `verify` checks the local ledger and fails closed on unknown hashes; remote fetch and signature checks are not built.
- `content_hash` is a real sha256 over the normalized skill directory.
- `skills-sh search|inspect|proof` is a read-only integration that needs a `SKILLS_SH_TOKEN` Vercel OIDC token.
- `ledger/`, `actions/capability-diff/` and `evals/` are not in the repository.
- `eval` parses its flags and echoes them; the harness is v0.2 work.

## Documentation

- [Guide](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/guide/): overview and orientation.
- [Getting started](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/guide/getting-started): build the CLI, scan a directory, diff two manifests.
- [Core concepts](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/guide/concepts): why the diff matters more than the manifest, and why records are keyed by content hash.
- [CLI reference](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/guide/cli): every command, argument and exit code.
- [Evaluations](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/guide/evaluations): the planned model-bump regression harness.
- [Ledger](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/guide/ledger): the append-only, content-addressed log.
- [Read API](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/api/): the two read endpoints.
- [Skill proofs](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/skill/): content-addressed capability proofs, one page per skill, each with a verify command and raw JSON.
- [Changelog](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/changelog): what shipped, newest first.
- [Manifesto](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/manifesto) and [Roadmap](https://ravaniroshan.github.io/skillproof/roadmap): the position, and what would stop the project.

## Machine-readable contracts

- [openapi/v1.yaml](https://github.com/RavaniRoshan/skillproof/blob/main/openapi/v1.yaml): read API contract, generated from the Zod schemas.
- [manifest.schema.json](https://github.com/RavaniRoshan/skillproof/blob/main/packages/schemas/manifest.schema.json): capability manifest.
- [eval.schema.json](https://github.com/RavaniRoshan/skillproof/blob/main/packages/schemas/eval.schema.json): eval delta record.

## Source of truth

The site sources are markdown under `site/` in the repository, which is also where this file lives. Documentation and code move together; when a claim here and the code disagree, the code wins and the docs are the bug.
